gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Dark and dense, Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick stripe of lowercase through every line while its curve endings keep their distance. And over a longer passage that plain sans body stays steady beneath Dogica's heavy, wide-set headings.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads easily on screen, with a sizable x-height and curved letters whose wide mouths stay unclosed. Its strongest quality is that openness against Dogica's weight.
